root_implementation_recommendation: Use shared confidence regions as a correct engineering feature; do not pursue it as the novel SOTA mechanism without an additional task-specific advantage over equally shared structured confidence-sequence/pure-exploration controls.

deterministic_problem.model: One static p_theta(x)=A+B cos(x)+C sin(x); every paid observation and every proposed update refers to this SAME function.
deterministic_problem.update: For old x_j and candidate y_j, improvement is g_j(theta)=p(x_j)-p(y_j)=d_j dot(B,C), where d_j=(cos x_j-cos y_j,sin x_j-sin y_j). A cancels.
deterministic_problem.global_safety: Over the entire finite or adaptively proposed sequence, probability of ever approving a g_j<=0 update must be<=.01.
deterministic_problem.success: For a deterministic finite set with strictly positive improvements, require all approved with probability>=.95, or separately each approved with probability>=.95 for the information lower bound.
deterministic_problem.shared_certificate: Use one simultaneous anytime confidence region S_t for(A,B,C). Approve any proposed update only if inf_theta in S_t g_j(theta)>0. The single event theta_true in S_t for all t proves the whole-sequence error bound, even for updates selected from past data. No per-update error-budget restart is necessary.

sharp_geometry.lemma: If a finite set of nonzero update directions d_j admits some lambda with every d_j dot lambda>0, its generated cone lies in an open half-plane and has at most two extreme rays. Every d_j is a nonnegative linear combination of these extremes. Certifying the two extreme linear inequalities certifies all M signs.
sharp_geometry.proof: Rotate coordinates so lambda points horizontally. Every d_j has positive first coordinate. Normalize each d_j by that coordinate; each becomes(1,t_j). Every t_j lies between the minimum and maximum slopes, so(1,t_j) is a convex combination of those two normalized extremes. Restore the positive normalizations.
sharp_geometry.phase_form: Writing(B,C)=R(cos phi,sin phi), each true-positive sign restricts phi to an open semicircle. Their jointly feasible intersection is an angular interval with at most two active endpoints. Radius-zero models must remain in the confidence region until excluded; an unqualified phase interval is not a valid substitute.
sharp_geometry.exceptions: This two-ray reduction is for signs of homogeneous linear forms. Different required absolute improvement thresholds produce affine half-spaces with potentially many active facets. Random future directions also cannot be selected as the two extremes before they are proposed.

concrete_chain.construction: Let p(x)=1/2+R cos x and x_j=pi/3+j*pi/(3M), j=0,...,M. Every consecutive update decreases failure probability. Normalized chord directions are(sin midpoint,-cos midpoint), hence lie within angles[-pi/6,pi/6] around(B,C)=(R,0). Two extreme chords certify the entire chain.
concrete_chain.shared_four_angle_test: Sample each of0,pi,+pi/2,-pi/2 exactly n times. Estimate B and C by half-differences of the corresponding means. Hoeffding plus a four-arm union bound gives simultaneous mean errors<=e with probability>=.99 when n>=log800/(2e^2). On this event the coefficient confidence rectangle of radius e around the estimates has B>=R-2e and |C|<=2e.
concrete_chain.choice: Take e=R/8. Every normalized chain direction has dot product at least3 sqrt(3) R/8-R/8>0 throughout the rectangle. Thus all M updates are certified with probability>=.99, at a fixed cost independent of M.
concrete_chain.comparison: A reset endpoint-comparison strategy can be much worse as each short chord has a small raw probability difference. A same-information structured linear confidence region obtains the same M-independent cost immediately. The reuse gain is real but classical.

information_bound.null_union: For fixed directions D, let H_j={eta physical:d_j dot(B_eta,C_eta)<=0}. For any valid policy and any eta in H_j, data processing for the event approving j gives transcript KL>=kappa=kl(.95,.01).
information_bound.characteristic_time: If w is the expected paid-angle occupation measure normalized by expected total cost, chain rule gives E[N] integral kl(p_theta(x)||p_eta(x)) w(dx)>=kappa for every eta in union H_j. Thus E[N]>=kappa/I*(theta,D), where I*=sup_w inf_eta in union H_j integral kl(p_theta||p_eta)dw. This is the standard controlled-sensing/linear-identification characteristic-time structure, not a new theorem family.
information_bound.scope: This fixed-D information lower bound does not condition on a randomly selected set of successful updates.

no_uniform_free_sequence_counterexample.construction: For any0<epsilon<=1 use theta=(A,B,C)=(1/2,1/4,0) and direction d=(epsilon,1). The improvement is epsilon/4>0. The physical null eta=(1/2,1/4,-epsilon/4) has d dot(B_eta,C_eta)=0. Positive scaling realizes d as a circle chord direction without changing its sign.
no_uniform_free_sequence_counterexample.per_shot_bound: For every query angle, |p_theta-p_eta|<=epsilon/4 and q_eta(1-q_eta)>=1/8. The Bernoulli bound kl(p||q)<= (p-q)^2/[q(1-q)] gives per-shot KL<=epsilon^2/2.
no_uniform_free_sequence_counterexample.cost_obstruction: Any95%-successful globally safe certificate therefore needs E[N]>=2*kappa/epsilon^2, even with arbitrary adaptive angles and all old data charged. Sending a candidate direction toward the zero-improvement boundary prevents any uniform finite-cost guarantee.
no_uniform_free_sequence_counterexample.trajectory_warning: If a chain approaches an unknown optimum, the minimum angular margin can shrink as the number of steps grows; the fixed-margin reuse example does not remove this cost.

fair_comparators: A shared structured Bernoulli likelihood confidence sequence over(A,B,C).
A shared linear/generalized-linear pure-exploration design targeting the two active update constraints.
A fixed-design shared simultaneous confidence region when active design overhead is not justified.
novelty_boundary: Shared confidence sets, confidence sequences, phase inference and fixed-confidence linear identification are established ideas. This reduction alone supplies no basis for an international-leading claim.
